text:
Rowan (Growth): Heads-up — weekly KPI deck shows launch-post CTR steady but paid-led MQLs down ~22% vs last week. Putting this here for a quick triage.
Sam (Analytics): on it. initial glance: paid sessions have a higher bounce rate and a weird spike at ~11:10 PDT.
Lina (MarOps): did we change the tracking pixel or UTM normalization rules recently? I updated the campaign mapping last Tuesday but only for organic channels.
Jon (Product Marketing): we did tweak the hero copy for the organic blog; paid creative should be unchanged.
Sam (Analytics): quick SQL I ran to inspect campaign counts:
```
SELECT coalesce(utm_campaign, '(null)') as campaign, count(*) as convs
FROM conversions
WHERE conversion_date BETWEEN '2026-04-05' AND '2026-04-11'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY convs DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Sam (Analytics): result shows an uptick in (null) campaign conversions for sources coming through adproxy.example.com — looks like the ad proxy strips query params on some click paths.
Lina (MarOps): that matches my ticket with VendorX about their redirect layer (VX-78). They're testing a new redirect shim.
Rowan (Growth): for Friday's KPI email we need numbers that don't undercount paid. Can we add a pragmatic fallback for attribution in BI? even a session-based heuristic is fine.
Sam (Analytics): I can add a heuristic field to the daily ETL: prefer utm_campaign, else parse referer host and map to last session campaign, else map to ad-domain default. Will push to BI and update the launch_kpis dashboard. ETA ~50m.
bi-bot: dashboard "launch_kpis_overview" updated by Sam. https://bi.redwood/dash/launch_kpis_overview
Jon (Product Marketing): good plan. longer-term we should fingerprint campaigns server-side on registration (hidden field) so client-side utm loss doesn't kill attribution. low lift in reg flow.
Lina (MarOps): noted. I'll add hidden_campaign_token to the registration backlog. Also will keep VX-78 ticket updated.
Rowan (Growth): owners: Lina -> VendorX follow-up + reg backlog; Sam -> ETL heuristic + dashboard patch; Jon -> confirm paid creative unchanged in creative registry; Rowan -> re-run week-over-week once BI patch lands and finalize Friday email.
Sam (Analytics): will post an interim snapshot when ETL finishes.
Rowan (Growth): thanks team. Also, add a one-liner in the KPI email: "Attribution cleanup in progress; numbers may adjust." Keeps leadership looped. :memo:
